name: system_status
description: Check the backend's operational status: API/database health, system resource metrics (CPU/memory/disk), API usage statistics, detailed database health checks, environment info, the autonomous proactive-messaging agent's health, or a full combined status report.

action.description: backend_status: API+DB health summary. metrics: CPU/memory/disk usage. api_stats: usage counts. db_health: detailed DB diagnostics. environment: runtime config info. full_report: everything combined. proactive_status: whether the autonomous WhatsApp agent last succeeded or failed to send, and why. self_test: runs the regression test suite over known past bugs and reports pass/fail. skill_reliability: real success/failure rates, trend (IMPROVING/STABLE/DEGRADING), and average latency per skill from actual execution history — pass skill_name for one skill, omit for a full ranked report.

skill_name.description: Only used with action='skill_reliability'. Name of a specific skill to report on (e.g. 'github'). Omit to get a ranked report across every skill with execution history.
